author: Adjudicator
quote:
Horrible story. Bad characters. Insane amount of player limitations. 30fps. 
13 year development inflating all of these negative points. There's more, but not worth your time or money. Skip this labubu ass game and find a new current thing to be interested in.

author: Adjudicator
quote: Phantom Blade Zero is an absolute triumph. Its breathtaking art direction, fluid combat, and intense atmosphere create an experience that feels both stylish and unforgettable. Every encounter looks thrilling, every animation is packed with personality, and the world oozes mystery. The blend of cinematic action and martial arts is simply spectacular. Few games manage to feel this ambitious and distinctive. For me, Phantom Blade Zero represents everything exciting about modern action games. An incredible achievement!
